annotations.title: Flight + hotel city break from Tirana (live)

description: Live FLIGHT + HOTEL offer for any city with flights from Tirana (city breaks: Barcelona, Rome, Paris, Vienna…): the round-trip flight for the dates plus up to 10 hotels spread over the price levels (tier: budget / mid_range / upscale / luxury), each with the combined flight+hotel TOTAL for the party (flight_plus_hotel_total_eur), an approximate per-person price, stars, board, room, refundability, area, distance and its own link, and a summary of how many hotels exist per star class. HOTEL FILTERS: package budget, hotel price per night, stars, board (breakfast…), refundable only, NEAR A PLACE (near_lat + near_lng + radius_km — you supply the coordinates of the landmark, square or address the user names), sort. Every hotel price is a PRIVATE room unless include_hostels=true. Use the filters to match what the user asked — never answer "nothing suitable" from an unfiltered list. Give hotel_name for one specific hotel. INDICATIVE: nothing is booked automatically — the user sends a request on our flight+hotel page (link), our staff confirms the price and then sends a payment link. For Turkey/Egypt beach charter packages (Antalya, Bodrum…) use the charter_* tools instead. LIVE search with a limited daily allowance — never repeat an identical call, but DO call again with filters to refine: the same city, dates and party is answered from our cache and does not use the allowance. If the answer says live_search=false, give the user search_url (the same search pre-filled on our site, prices live there).

airline.description: Filter flights by airline name (only when the user asks).

board.description: Minimum board that must be INCLUDED in the price (the cheapest room WITH it is priced).

budget_total_max.description: Optional max TOTAL in EUR for flight + hotel together, whole party.

children_ages.description: Age of each child on the travel date (REQUIRED when children travel — prices depend on the exact age).

city.description: Destination city, English name (Barcelona, Milan, Rome). Multi-airport cities: the city name covers all airports.

direct_only.description: true = only non-stop flights (only when the user asks).

hotel_name.description: Optional: one specific hotel the user named.

hotel_price_per_night_max.description: Optional max HOTEL price per night in EUR for the whole party (the flight not counted).

include_hostels.description: true = also hostels, dormitory beds and rooms with a shared bathroom. ONLY when the user asks for a hostel or the absolute cheapest bed — by default every price is a private room with private bathroom.

near_lat.description: Latitude (decimal degrees) of the place the user wants to stay near — a landmark, square, station, venue or address. YOU supply the coordinates (e.g. Piazza del Duomo, Milan = 45.4642, 9.1900). Give near_lat and near_lng together.

radius_km.description: Radius around near_lat/near_lng in km (default 1.5 ≈ a 20-minute walk).

refundable_only.description: true = only cancellable (refundable) rates. The exact free-cancellation deadline is shown on our page before payment.

sort.description: Default "recommended" = a spread over budget / mid-range / upscale / luxury, central real hotels first. "price_low" = literally the cheapest, wherever they are.
